title: If any sailing vessel attempts to ply or
text:
129.

If any sailing vessel attempts to ply or
proceed to sea without free board
markings or is so loaded as to submerge
such markings, or plies or proceeds to sea
without a certificate of inspection as required by sub-section (1) of section 421,
or if any of the terms and conditions
specified in such certificate are

contravened.

420(3),

421

The owner or tindal shall
be liable to imprisonment
which may extend to six
months, or to fine which
may extend to five

hundred rupees, or both.
